verdict: GO for fixed helper geometry/formulas; receipt completion and ordered-ID integration required before runner qualification
scope: Full original source plus worker diff at the stated hash; source-only, no imports, controller calls, tests, kinematics, integration or physics executed. Worker tests were not yet present when inspected; this is not final runner approval.

root_actions.finding: Binding stores wheel_local_positions and wheel_local_quaternions but as_receipt omits them. The contract requires the compiled local transforms to be recorded once.
root_actions.minimal_fix: Add both numeric nested-list fields to the outer binding receipt, or add them to as_receipt when integrating the worker. No geometric formula change required.

root_actions.finding: Actual D1Plant.wheel_body_ids is frozenset; wheel_body_ids_by_leg is the canonical ordered tuple FL/FR/RL/RR. The helper rejects Mapping and unordered sets. Passing either directly is a runtime TypeError.
root_actions.minimal_fix: Use plant.wheel_body_ids_by_leg plus plant.floor_geom_id as already specified. If a separate adapter supplies a name-to-ID Mapping, validate its exact canonical keys and extract values by FL/FR/RL/RR order; never list(mapping) or rely on insertion/set order.

checked.contact_margin: Fixed wheel margin 0.001, floor margin 0 and both gaps 0 produce contact_margin_m=0.001. The fixed clearance threshold is strictly >0.021 m. This is restricted to the validated native plane model, not an arbitrary contact-pair/override or future obstacle model.
checked.cylinder_support: Correct support R*sqrt(1-(n dot a)^2)+L*abs(n dot a); a is geom_xmat third COLUMN (local cylinder z). Horizontal axis gives R, vertical gives L. Signed negative gaps are retained.
checked.sampling: Reducer joins only adjacent true saved intervals within 1e-10 s and rejects overlap beyond 1e-12 s. It neither selects 20 ms nor proves unsampled continuous flight. Scorer must independently require >=10 native intervals, summed actual duration >=0.020 s with the fixed rounding tolerance, zero active contacts/load, returned endpoint gap>margin, and positive whole-COM vz at run start.
checked.json: sample_wheel_clearance returns plain numeric/list schema, wheel IDs, all four gaps, simultaneous minimum, margin, plane ID/normal/offset. Caller must attach pose/time provenance and separate native force-cache phase; helper does not invent timestamps, COM or flight labels.
checked.worker_diff: Adds model_ngeom and whole-array row-count validation; formula and reducer unchanged. Count guards truncated arrays but is not proof of same-model identity; runner model/source binding remains necessary.
checked.hidden_dynamics: None found. Only possible MuJoCo call is mj_id2name for name lookup. No MjData creation, reset, forward, collision, solver or step call.
